observation.visible_scene: A stationary indoor tabletop/floor setup on pinkish tiles: a vertical clear lamp tube seated in a gray cylindrical socket glows intensely at center, wired to a beige rectangular box (ballast/driver) lying flat on the left, with white and gray cords snaking across the surface. Behind it a white shelf holds two gold bow-tie-shaped fixtures and stacked boxes/cups on top. The whole arrangement does not move.
visible_changes: The central lamp remains lit throughout, but its brightness and the surrounding glare/lens-flare halo (horizontal streaks, rainbow artifacts, diffuse bloom) fluctuate subtly from frame to frame, consistent with a flickering or pulsing light source rather than any object motion.
No translation, deformation, or camera pan is detectable: the beige box, gray socket, cords, gold fixtures and shelf items keep the same positions and relative layout across all frames.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the light flicker continues or stabilizes beyond the crop, and what drives it (e.g. mains frequency, failing component).
The function/identity of the beige box and the purpose of the test setup.
uncertain_details: The apparent intensity variation could partly be compression/exposure noise rather than true lamp flicker.
Exact cause of the bright glow (fluorescent vs. discharge tube) is not confirmable from the images.
